profile.title: Frontend Engineer building web products and AI-assisted tools
profile.intro: I build web products with a frontend focus, drawing on more than a decade of experience. My work spans customer-facing commerce, admin platforms and tools for internal users and external partners. More recently, I have extended that work into Python-based knowledge search and LLM-assisted workflow automation, focusing on tools people can use in their daily work.

strengths: turning repetitive operational work into usable tools
structuring complex admin workflows and reusable frontend foundations
connecting user interfaces, APIs and automation into working product flows
moving prototypes through review, release and practical use

experience_highlights.summary: Developed and maintained web interfaces for product discovery, cart and checkout, with attention to accessibility and device compatibility.
Built and modernized frontend platforms for commerce operators and external partners, including legacy migration and API integration.
Built reusable content modules and editing tools that let operators publish and update pages without repeated development and deployment work.
Developed AI-assisted manual generation workflows with human review, and extended them to partner-facing and internal admin tools.
Built knowledge search and Q&A tools with retrieval-augmented generation, reranking and source-backed responses.

working_style: validate ideas with small prototypes and cross-functional feedback
check operational edge cases and verify behavior during migrations
keep human review and clear failure conditions in AI-assisted workflows
